films.title: Mozvane
films.blurb: Sora-era anime with daBeezy — the community's first cinematic experiment in the archive's cosmic tone.
films.lore: Mozvane isn't separate from the collection; it's the same restless energy as the pieces: raw, playful, and still being shaped by the clowder.

community_notes.title: Telegram is where it started
